note: Both sets correctly assign W10X15 to the floor beams and W8X13 to the roof beams, and both capture the 1/2" opening edge radius note. However, both swap the keynote callouts: A1 is FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6 and A4 is FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 2 (and B1 is FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5, B4 is FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 3), so four claims in each set carry misbound conditions. Set A is slightly better because it keeps the full 'ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6 & NEAR GRID 5' description with C1, whereas Set B truncates that entity/quote to 'ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6' and also repeats the E6 roof beam claim as a redundant duplicate.
